```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```

#Read in and collate all the files in the Processed Data folder 
```{r}

##SO4/Cl

#2022 - ##MSM WC 202209 RHZ don't have identifier other than a #, unclear what these are related to
dionex_files_2022 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfate_Chloride/Synoptic-CB/2022/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
#Read and combine all CSVs
dionex_2022 <- dionex_files_2022 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data MSM_202210_TR_RHZ_10
dionex_RHZ_2022 <- dionex_2022 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ")) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, "^[^_]*_"))

##Nutr MSM_202211_RHZ_WC_9 data is formatted differently from MSM_202210_WC_RHZ_9
dionex_RHZ_2022 <- dionex_RHZ_2022 %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = ifelse(Date == "202208", paste(Date, Site, Zone, Replicate, Depth, Tree, sep = "_"), Sample_ID)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("_NA", "", Sample_ID))

dionex_RHZ_2022 <- dionex_RHZ_2022 %>% #202207_MSM_TR_RHZ_Tree_6
  mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("SF_", "SF", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("Col_", "Col", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("Tree_", "SF", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("Sip_", "Sip", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("SIp_", "Sip", Sample_ID)) %>% 
  separate(Sample_ID, into = c("Date", "Site", "Sampler_Type", "Zone", "Replicate"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) 
  
dionex_RHZ_2022 <- dionex_RHZ_2022 %>%
  mutate(Zone = ifelse(Zone == "RHZ", Sampler_Type, Zone))

dionex_RHZ_2022 <- dionex_RHZ_2022 %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Site, Date, Zone, "RHZ", Replicate, sep = "_")) 

#Select only data columns
colnames(dionex_RHZ_2022)
dionex_RHZ_sel_2022 <- dionex_RHZ_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "SO4_ppm",   "Cl_ppm",    "SO4_mM" ,   "Cl_mM"   ,  "salinity" )


#2023
dionex_files_2023 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfate_Chloride/Synoptic-CB/2023/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
#Read and combine all CSVs
dionex_2023 <- dionex_files_2023 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data MSM_202210_TR_RHZ_10
dionex_RHZ_2023 <- dionex_2023 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ")) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, "^[^_]*_"))

dionex_RHZ_2023 <- dionex_RHZ_2023 %>% #MSM_202207_TR_RHZ_Tree6
  mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("SF_", "SF", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("SFCollar_", "Col", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("Collar_", "Col", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("Collar", "Col", Sample_ID),
         Sample_ID = gsub("Tree_", "", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("Sip_", "Sip", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("SipB_", "Sip", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("SIp_", "Sip", Sample_ID)) %>% 
  separate(Sample_ID, into = c("Site", "Date", "Zone", "Sampler_Type", "Replicate"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) 

dionex_RHZ_2023 <- dionex_RHZ_2023 %>%
  mutate(Zone = ifelse(Zone == "RHZ", Sampler_Type, Zone)) %>%
  mutate(Replicate = ifelse(Depth == "SipB", Depth, Replicate))

dionex_RHZ_2023 <- dionex_RHZ_2023 %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Site, Date, Zone, "RHZ", Replicate, sep = "_")) 

#Select only data columns
colnames(dionex_RHZ_2023)
dionex_RHZ_sel_2023 <- dionex_RHZ_2023 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "SO4_ppm",   "Cl_ppm",    "SO4_mM" ,   "Cl_mM"   ,  "salinity" )

#Combine 2022 and 2023
dionex_RHZ_sel <- bind_rows(dionex_RHZ_sel_2022, dionex_RHZ_sel_2023)
dionex_RHZ_sel$Sample_ID <- toupper(dionex_RHZ_sel$Sample_ID)


##Sulfide - need to fix sample IDs 
#2022

sulfide_RHZ_2022 <- sulfide_RHZ_2022 %>% #GWI_202207_TR_RHZ_TREE1
  mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("TREE", "SF", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("SF_", "SF", Sample_ID)) %>% 
  separate(Sample_ID, into = c("Site", "Date", "Zone", "Sampler_Type", "Replicate"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) 
  
sulfide_RHZ_2022 <- sulfide_RHZ_2022 %>%
  mutate(Zone = ifelse(Zone == "RHZ", Sampler_Type, Zone))

sulfide_RHZ_2022 <- sulfide_RHZ_2022 %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Site, Date, Zone, "RHZ", Replicate, sep = "_")) 

#Select only data columns
colnames(sulfide_RHZ_2022)
sulfide_RHZ_sel_2022 <- sulfide_RHZ_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "H2S_mean"     ,    "H2S_sd"        ,   "H2S_cv"          ,
"H2S_Conc_flag"  ,  "H2S_cv_flag"   ,   "H2S_QAQC_flag"  , "Run_notes",        "Field_notes") %>% 
  rename(H2S_Run_notes = Run_notes)


#2023
sulfide_files_2023 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfide/Synoptic-CB/2023/Processed Data", pattern = "Combined\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
# 3. Read and combine all CSVs
sulfide_data_2023 <- sulfide_files_2023 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data
sulfide_RHZ_2023 <- sulfide_data_2023 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ"))


##According to nutrient data, MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_1 should be MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_Col1 and MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_A should be MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_SipA
sulfide_RHZ_2023 <- sulfide_RHZ_2023 %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("MSM_202309_TR_RHZ_", "MSM_202309_TR_RHZ_SF", Sample_ID),
         Sample_ID = gsub("MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_A", "MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_LysA", Sample_ID),  
         Sample_ID = gsub("MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_C", "MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_LysC", Sample_ID),
         Sample_ID = gsub("MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_1", "MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_Col1", Sample_ID), 
         Sample_ID = gsub("MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_2", "MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_Col2", Sample_ID),
         Sample_ID = gsub("MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_3", "MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_Col3", Sample_ID),
         Sample_ID = gsub("MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_4", "MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_Col4", Sample_ID),
         Sample_ID = gsub("MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_5", "MSM_202309_WC_RHZ_Col5", Sample_ID))



sulfide_RHZ_2023 <- sulfide_RHZ_2023 %>% #GWI_202207_TR_RHZ_TREE1
  separate(Sample_ID, into = c("Site", "Date", "Zone", "Sampler_Type", "Replicate"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) 
  
sulfide_RHZ_2023 <- sulfide_RHZ_2023 %>%
  mutate(Zone = ifelse(Zone == "RHZ", Sampler_Type, Zone))

sulfide_RHZ_2023 <- sulfide_RHZ_2023 %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Site, Date, Zone, "RHZ", Replicate, sep = "_")) 

#Select only data columns
colnames(sulfide_RHZ_2023)
sulfide_RHZ_sel_2023 <- sulfide_RHZ_2023 %>% 
  rename(H2S_mean = H2S_mean_uM, 
         H2S_sd = H2S_sd_uM) %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "H2S_mean"     ,    "H2S_sd"        ,   "H2S_cv"          ,
"H2S_Conc_flag"  ,  "H2S_cv_flag"   ,   "H2S_QAQC_flag"  , "Run_notes",        "Field_notes") %>% 
  rename(H2S_Run_notes = Run_notes)


#Combine 2022 and 2023
sulfide_RHZ_sel <- bind_rows(sulfide_RHZ_sel_2022, sulfide_RHZ_sel_2023)
sulfide_RHZ_sel$Sample_ID <- toupper(sulfide_RHZ_sel$Sample_ID)
```

##Write out files
```{r write out combined data and metadata, include=FALSE}

#write out a csv of all the data to the main folder: 
colnames(joined_data)
final_data <- joined_data %>% 
  mutate(Project = "COMPASS: Synoptic", 
         Region = "CB") %>% 
  rename(H2S_mean_uM = H2S_mean, 
         H2S_sd_uM = H2S_sd, 
         FE_2_mean_uM = FE_2_mean, 
         FE_2_sd_uM = FE_2_sd, 
         FE_3_mean_uM = FE_3_mean, 
         FE_3_sd_uM = FE_3_sd) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Sample_ID, #GWI_202209_TR_RHZ_SF1
    sep = "_",
    into = c("Site", "Date", "Zone", "Sampler_Type", "Replicate"),
    remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Month = as.numeric(substr(Date, 5, 6)), 
         Year = as.numeric(substr(Date, 1, 4))) 


##Pull in metadata dates
metadata_2022 <- read.csv("COMPASS_SynopticCB_PW_SampleLog_2022.csv")
metadata_2023 <- read.csv("COMPASS_SynopticCB_PW_SampleLog_2023.csv")
metadat <- bind_rows(metadata_2022, metadata_2023)

metadat <- metadat %>% 
  select("Year", "Month", "Day", "Site", "Transect.Location") %>% 
  rename(Zone = Transect.Location) %>% 
  mutate(Zone = case_when(
    `Zone` == "Upland" ~ "UP",
    `Zone` == "Transition" ~ "TR",
    `Zone` == "Wetland" ~ "WC",   
    `Zone` == "UPCON" ~ "UPCON",
    `Zone` == "Surface Water" ~ "SW",
    TRUE                 ~ `Zone`    # keep original value if no match
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    Zone = case_when(
      Site == "SWH" & Zone == "UP" & Year == 2023 ~ "SWAMP",
      Site == "SWH" & Zone == "UPCON" & Year == 2023 ~ "UP",
      TRUE ~ `Zone`
    )) 

metadat <- unique(metadat)


final_data1 <- final_data %>% 
  left_join(metadat, by = c("Year", "Month", "Site", "Zone"))

final_data1 <- final_data1 %>%
  select(c("Project", "Site", "Year", "Month", "Day", "Sample_ID", "Zone", "Sampler_Type", "Replicate", "SO4_ppm", "Cl_ppm", "SO4_mM", "Cl_mM", "salinity", "H2S_mean_uM", "H2S_sd_uM", "H2S_Conc_flag", "NH3_mgL", "NH3_uM", "NH3_range", "PO4_mgL", "PO4_uM", "PO4_range", "NOx_mgL", "NOx_uM", "NOx_range", "FE_2_mean_uM", "FE_2_sd_uM", "FE_3_mean_uM", "FE_3_sd_uM", "FE_2_flag", "FE_3_flag"))



##Export final data
write.csv(final_data1, "COMPASS_SynopticCB_Rhizon_Data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
